description: This file implements the GeminiEmbedder class, which wraps the OpenAICompatibleEmbedder to provide embedding functionality using Google's Gemini API. It includes methods for creating embeddings, validating configuration, and retrieving embedder info.

classes.name: GeminiEmbedder
classes.description: A class that provides embedding capabilities via Google's Gemini API, wrapping an OpenAI-compatible embedder.

methods.name: createEmbeddings
methods.description: Creates text embeddings using Gemini's API, with error handling and telemetry logging.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the embedder configuration by delegating to the underlying openAICompatibleEmbedder.

methods.name: embedderInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the embedder, specifically its name.
